theorem_statement: The CLIV Seeley-DeWitt ratios are generated by the same W(3,3) grammar: a2/a0 is the index-asymmetry step eta(0)/ind(D)=14/3, while a4/a2 is the Hashimoto radial-wedge over threshold-field step C(k-1,2)/Phi6=55/7. The Higgs quartic is the inverse radial-threshold step lambda_H=7/55.
